reason: An archive deposit with no available manuscript does not enter the cohort, however good its metadata. Cryptic is defined against what the authors claimed about pathogens, so a deposit nobody has written up has no claim to define it against: no methods to verify the setting, no statement of what was expected, therefore no way to classify a detection as cryptic or not. Applies prospectively; no project currently in the field cohort fails it. 'Has a manuscript' is a test on the DATA, not on one paper: the Sato 2024 Arabidopsis cluster passes because Sato et al. 2024 describes the field experiment and Tomita et al. v3 the sequencing, even though the RNA-seq has no dedicated paper
